snippet.title: The Adventures Of Gael Longsword - The dwarves fly off to Mercia
snippet.description:
Here is a clip from my open world RPG fantasy steampunk game, soon to be on STEAM as a playable demo.
The game features elements such as horror, platforming, sarcastic and funny characters, beautiful scenery and a great soundtrack i produced myself. 
The FULL game will be released next spring.
